title: Who will win the women's singles squash gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games?
background: The 2026 Asian Games are scheduled to take place in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official Asian Games results or reliable news reporting of the women's singles squash final. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the player awarded the women's singles squash gold medal upon completion of the final at the 2026 Asian Games. Team and doubles results do not count. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The gold medallist's full name.
